Description:
With the colder weather in the Netherlands in December the very famous and traditional peasoup will be served multiple times. It is made with dried split peas and it is nothing like you have tasted before. Try out this recipe which is known by every Dutch person.

Equipment used to produce this video:
Smartphone Oneplus 2 as camera.
Low budget tripod with flexible standard.
Software used to edit video footage used is Lightworks.
